architecture:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent sprite atlas for a desktop 2D Three Kingdoms action RPG. The attached image is ONLY a STYLE REFERENCE for the existing chibi Zhao Yun: match its polished illustrated Chinese fantasy game aesthetic, confident fine dark contours, hand-painted rich materials, soft highlights, crisp detailed small shapes, warm light from upper left and cool restrained shadows. DO NOT include Zhao Yun or any other people.

Create ONE 2048x1024 transparent RGBA sprite atlas arranged in EXACTLY 4 equal columns by 2 equal rows, each 512x512 cell. Exactly one complete isolated prop centered in each cell; clear transparent gutters of at least 35 px around every prop; nothing overlaps cells; no text, labels, borders or background ground planes. All props use the SAME game camera: orthographic oblique top-down at about 45 degrees looking toward the front; visible front facade and roof, very little side face, horizontal front ground edge. These are actual cutout game sprites, not isometric diamond base icons. Contact shadow small and soft, every object stands on a clear bottom-center ground contact.

Row 1 left to right:
1. A lived-in Han-era modest cottage with teal-grey individually overlapping clay roof tiles, slightly uneven eaves, aged cream plaster revealing a few bricks, deep brown wooden posts, recessed door and latticed window, subtle moss at foot. Rounded chibi architecture proportions, charming not childish.
2. The same visual family as a war-damaged village house: visibly collapsed corner of tiled roof, a few broken rafters, smoky plaster near door, some roof still intact. Ground-level footprint intact, asymmetric readable silhouette, restrained rubble held close to the walls.
3. A ruined small ancestral temple hall with a substantial tiled roof, gently upturned eaves, carved dark wooden lintel, worn red-brown columns, cracked pale stone plinth, partly missing roof section. No symbols, inscriptions or decorative glowing effects.
4. A freestanding weathered timber gateway spanning an open passage, two substantial posts and a teal-grey tiled roof with detailed layered eaves, readable open middle, no wall across the passage.

Row 2 left to right:
5. A canvas grain-camp tent with warm flax fabric, rounded folds and tension seams, worn leather corner ties, timber pole, dark opening, two tied sacks at one corner. No flag.
6. A military command tent with muted blue-green cloth, real draped fabric folds, cream seam binding, darker side, reinforced tied opening. No letters, symbols or flag.
7. A broad low natural slate outcrop for a rocky pass. Wide horizontal silhouette, irregular grounded corners, layered chipped stone with soft painted planes and fine veins, patches of subtle moss. It must look like natural weathered geology, NOT a rectangle/cuboid, not a pile of faceted low-poly triangles. At least twice as wide as tall.
8. A compact wooden supply rack with three tied grain sacks, small stacked wicker baskets, visible timber grain, rope lashings and straw, stable wide base.

Style must look drawn for the same game as the supplied hero, not a flat vector icon, not a low-poly render, not photorealistic, not glossy plastic. Materials and edge quality should remain readable after downscaling each sprite to 140-240 px wide. Balanced saturation, avoid neon, excessive moss, ornamental clutter or random scratches. Exact clean transparent background.
nature:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production natural-prop sprite atlas, same polished hand-painted chibi Chinese fantasy RPG art direction as the attached Zhao Yun style reference. Do NOT depict the hero or people. Transparent RGBA, canvas 2048x1024, EXACTLY 4 columns x 2 rows of isolated props, equal cells, generous 45px clear transparent gutters so each prop can be cut without touching any neighbor. No labels, text, ground-base diamonds, borders, decorative scenery or background. Fixed orthographic oblique top-down 45-degree camera looking toward front, matching 2D game buildings; small dark contact shadow directly under roots. Upper-left warm light, soft cool shadows, detailed fine dark contours and luminous hand-painted edges like the hero's hair and armor. Materials should be rich and dimensional but NOT photorealistic/3D/low-poly/flat vector. Restrained earth/olive/teal palette and readable small silhouettes.
Row1: (1) one wind-shaped old hillside oak, irregular rounded asymmetrical clustered foliage in muted olive and dusty gold, visible twisting trunk, subtly lit leaf masses, not geometric canopy; (2) one war-scorched leafless elm, natural branching exposed bark and broken branches, strong warm-grey trunk texture, no burning fire; (3) one slender old cypress, gracefully tapering layered deep sage foliage with individual painted needles and a visible trunk; (4) one old riverside willow, asymmetric trunk, hanging thin foliage ribbons in dusty sage, detailed slender leaves without opaque curtain covering the ground.
Row2: (5) a tight small bamboo clump with 6 uneven jointed culms, fine lush olive/blue-green bamboo leaf clusters and visible lower culms, realistic botanical rhythm; (6) a low scrub/fern cluster rooted among a couple of small stones, dimensional curling leaves and earthy roots, no large ground patch; (7) a small rounded slate boulder group with fractured but weather-softened edges, subtle mineral veins and modest moss, not angular geometric triangles; (8) a squat deep rocky outcrop with 3 interlocked irregular weathered stone lobes, front and back ground contact depth visible, grey-green layered rock with soft hand-painted lighting, roughly one-and-a-half times as wide as tall.
Each object must stay fully inside its cell and have a clean transparent silhouette. Leave breathing room. No loose floating fragments. Render for downscale to 50-180px in game.
materials:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE 1536x1024 production terrain texture atlas for a polished illustrated Chinese chibi action RPG. Six square material panels in an exact 3 columns x 2 rows layout, each panel fills its cell completely, zero gutters/borders/text. STRICT straight-down orthographic flat ground view. Every panel should tile seamlessly on all four sides by itself: consistent color and texture density at opposite edges, no vignettes, spotlights, directional gradients or center features.
Top row left-to-right: (1) warm compacted brown-beige earthen village road, fine irregular soil grains and subtle shallow foot-worn abrasion, not cracked desert; (2) cool damp riverbank silt in brown olive-grey, soft smears and a few flush tiny pebbles, no puddles or raised rocks; (3) weathered exposed grey-green slate ground, broad naturally irregular overlapping mineral strata, subtle tiny seams and granular surface, low relief, no geometric triangular planes or large fissures.
Bottom row left-to-right: (4) old Chinese courtyard flagstones: softly rounded uneven shallow slate slabs, broken mortar and sparse tiny moss in joints, imperfect nonuniform paving, no repeating perfect rectangles/grid; (5) muted olive grass mixed with earthy soil: short soft tuft edges and small exposed soil areas, organically grouped, no repeated V blades, no flowers; (6) bamboo grove humus: dark olive-brown fine organic ground with sparse narrow ochre/olive bamboo leaf fragments, small scale, no complete branches or vegetation.
High quality hand-painted game texture matching detailed ink-contoured chibi characters, warm soft highlights and neutral ambient shadow, delicate layered brushwork and convincing material grain. Surface features must be small enough to sit below a character's boot scale when used across a game map. LOW CONTRAST playfield, readable silhouettes above it, no rocks/boulders/trees/props/characters/roads/painted symbols, no photorealism, no plastic/low-poly/vector style. Keep light and dark variation within a narrow midtone range so repetition does not create a patchwork of obvious squares. No alpha; fill entire canvas.
utility:
Create ONE transparent production prop atlas for the same finely illustrated chibi Chinese Three Kingdoms game as the reference hero. Hero is STYLE ONLY; no characters. 2048x1024 canvas, 4 columns x2 rows, eight fully isolated complete objects with generous clear transparent gutters. No labels, inscriptions, frames, colored background or diamond bases. Consistent orthographic 45-degree top-down oblique camera, upper-left warm light, soft cool shadows, fine dark outline, detailed hand-painted wood/stone/cloth, gently rounded stylized silhouettes, charming believable craft. Not low-poly, flat vector, photorealistic, glossy plastic, neon or overdecorated. Each prop must fit inside its cell. Front ground-contact edge clear, contact shadows small.
Top row:
1 weathered rectangular stone offering altar, low and broad with softened carved edging, two small unlit bronze incense bowls and a plain central stone tablet; age and fine mineral texture, no readable text, no jewel or glow.
2 a narrow old freestanding memorial stele on a small square foot, uneven weather-softened grey stone, faint eroded inset panel without text, no decorative jewel.
3 an open village well with round stone curb and dark opening, two plain weathered wooden hoist uprights and crossbeam, rope spool and a small bucket, ground-visible open structure.
4 a wooden lantern post with a warm ivory paper lantern hanging on a short horizontal arm, small stone foot, visible wood grain and rope binding.
Bottom row:
5 a short wide timber palisade section with five individually uneven sharpened logs and two horizontal crossbeams, coarse bark and rope lashings; roughly twice as wide as tall, clear feet.
6 one single standalone timber palisade stake with pointed top, coarse natural bark, a small rope binding around its middle; no crossbeam.
7 an abandoned small wooden boat rib-frame seen from the same elevated game view, wide horizontal orientation, natural curved ribs and keel, weathered overlapping timber boards along bottom, no water and no mast.
8 an old wooden footbridge deck seen from elevated top-down, narrow vertically in the cell, many irregular wooden planks and two low simple rails, no tall posts/arch or water; parallel long edges, worn wood and subtle moss at ends.
Keep the same finely shaded game-illustration quality as the reference. Fine detail must survive shrinking to 70-220px.
